messages:
Priya Nair: Hi all 900
I wanted to request help with a seating change. I have a sensory processing sensitivity that's flaring with the open office noise near the north windows. My clinician recommended low-stimulus seating or permission to use noise-cancelling headphones. Can People Ops advise on next steps for an ADA accommodation?

Noah Kim: Thanks for flagging this, Priya. Totally support getting you set up. @Maria Gomez (People Ops) could you outline the paperwork and options? I can be flexible with swapping desks if needed.

Maria Gomez (People Ops): Hi Priya 4: we can absolutely support. Two practical routes: 1) temporary/operational workaround (noise-cancelling headphones, flexible schedule, remote days) which we can implement quickly, or 2) formal ADA accommodation (form + clinician note) for a permanent seating change or private space. If you want the formal route please send hr+accomms@redwood.com the accommodation form and medical note. Either way well treat docs as confidential.

Priya Nair: I like to try the quick route first (headphones + a quieter desk) while I get the clinician note together. Is there a quiet desk available?

Ben Torres: Hey Priya 4: Im at the desk next to the north windows. I didnt realize it was causing issues. If swapping helps, I can move closer to the lounge temporarily. No problem.

Noah Kim: Appreciate that, Ben. Before we move desks can Facilities confirm available spots? @Facilities Bot can you show nearby available desks and any small rooms for focus work?

Facilities Bot: Available desks (today): Desk E12 (near engineers bay, quieter), Desk B03 (by meeting pods), Focus Room 2 (bookable for half-day). To reserve desks/rooms, reply with the desk code or book via the office portal.

Priya Nair: E12 sounds ideal. Could someone reserve for me Mon-Fri 10:00-16:00 for the next two weeks while I gather documentation?

Noah Kim: I can handle booking if Facilities needs a manager to approve. Ben, Ill DM you about the exact swap logistics.

Maria Gomez (People Ops): Quick process note: we'll flag this in our tracking system as an Accommodation Inquiry (private). If you go with the temporary workaround, well still recommend submitting the form if you expect this to be ongoing beyond two weeks. That helps speed any permanent changes.

Samir Shah (Legal): Two quick compliance notes: 1) Keep medical info restricted to hr+accomms and People Ops staff; 2) if a teammates duties are materially affected by seating moves, assess any safety/security impacts (unlikely here).

Priya Nair: Thanks Samir. Ill email the form and a brief clinician note by end of week just to keep the option open. For now headphones + E12 reservation would be great.

Facilities Bot: Reservation confirmed: Desk E12 reserved for Priya Nair Mon-Fri 10:00-16:00 through 2 weeks starting 1764182400 (note: reservations use root timestamp). Keycard update not required for this temporary swap.

Ben Torres: Cool, thanks Priya. Ill shift my stuff Friday afternoon. LMK if you need help moving monitors.

Noah Kim: Ill add calendar blocks to reflect Priyas hours and ping the team about a temporary availability change so standups know.

Maria Gomez (People Ops): Ordering note: If Priya prefers noise-cancelling headphones we can approve a standard model up to $250 without formal paperwork. Raise a ticket to People Ops procurement and tag @eng-infra for delivery scheduling.

Priya Nair: Perfect 4: please order headphones and thanks everyone for being flexible. Appreciate the quick response.

Samir Shah (Legal): One last thing 4: manager please avoid documenting medical details in public channels. Use People Ops thread or private notes only.

Noah Kim: Understood. Ill keep it to People Ops DM notes only.

Priya Nair: Thanks all 4: Ill follow up after I send the form. This is much better already. :relieved:
